name: l1-condition-dropped-in-move
summary: moved to `pricing.shipping`, the free-shipping rule lost `and order["country"] == HOME_COUNTRY`: an order abroad from 50 ships free
probe:
from orders import add_line, new_order
from pricing import shipping
order = new_order("a", "FR")
add_line(order, "pen", 10.0, 6)
assert shipping(order) == 12.50
